verdictExplanation: Splitline run through its own engine, using its own committed intake.

intake.title: Splitline: AI-assisted operating-model triage
intake.processDescription: Practitioners describe a proposed AI use case in plain words and answer structured context questions. A large language model proposes a breakdown into subtasks with attributes; the user edits and confirms every subtask before anything is analyzed. A deterministic rules engine then computes the indicative tier, the triggered rules, the verdict and the operating model. The language model only writes a short narrative from the engine's facts, and a guard rejects any rule it was not given. Users are told not to enter personal information.

subtasks.name: Propose a subtask breakdown
subtasks.description: The language model splits the description into subtasks and proposes attributes for each.
subtasks.rationale: A proposal only; the user edits and confirms it before analysis.

subtasks.name: Confirm the breakdown and split
subtasks.description: The user reviews, edits and confirms every subtask and attribute.
subtasks.rationale: The user knows the process; the tool dogfoods its human-in-the-loop principle.

subtasks.name: Check rules and compute the tier
subtasks.description: The deterministic engine evaluates the rule catalogue, the indicative tier, the verdict and the operating model.
subtasks.rationale: Codified rules with sources; tested against golden cases.

subtasks.name: Write the narrative
subtasks.description: The language model writes a short explanation from the engine's facts; a guard rejects unknown rules.
subtasks.rationale: Restates engine facts; falls back to template text when the guard fails.
